notes.title: Forest Level Revamp for PlayNYC - Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Squires!

The Knights of the Island have been hard at work since we first put the playtest up in June. We have been getting ready for PlayNYC at AnimeNYC, where we presented the game this past weekend. For the convention we revamped the entire first level of Wyshbound with a completely different layout and added many different quality-of-life improvements. [/p][list][*][p]Changes to Forest Level Include:,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated layout to increase exploration,[/p][/*][*][p]New NPCs to interact with,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated existing sprites with new art style,[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization pass,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated / added cutscenes,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dungeon design,[/p][/*][/list][p] We are excited to show off this new update with our existing playtesters along with the new squires from PlayNYC! The update to the playtest is out NOW, so please try it out, give us feedback, and let us know what you think. We will be continuing to add updates in the upcoming months, so keep a lookout! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638052/748440451eb11c8010ce1a782f0b166e8291b432.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 6/3
notes.content:
Hello Squires!

We have just put out another hotfix for the playtest build. This build includes:

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed talking to the horses with Pandora freezing the game 
- Fixed Pandora's grapple rope not appearing during her intro cutscene
- Fixed Pandora being able to shoot early during her intro cutscene
- Fixed the timing on some cutscene events in Pandora's intro cutscene to prevent the game from freezing when she tries to shoot over the pit

Improved Graphics:
- Updated several sprites around the Forest and Birden

UI Updates:
- Swapped out the old Wyshlist button found in the Settings menu in-game
- Added a dialogue window that warns players that the mouse is disabled during gameplay if they try to use it on the Main Menu

Lastly, saves are now stored in Documents/Knights Of The Island/Wyshbound. They were previously stored in the game files, which caused saves to be overwritten with each update. If you didn't install the previous update, you can retrieve your SaveData folder and place it in the new location. If you did install the previous update, unfortunately, all previous save files are lost. We apologize for the inconvenience.

We hope you continue to enjoy the playtest, and we will continue updating as we test and get more feedback!

From,
Knights of the Island

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix 5/29
notes.content:
Hello Squires!

We have just put out a new hotfix for the playtest build that includes:

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed for lighting issue when lighting something on fire
- Fixed some doors in town not opening
- Fixed issue where pumpkin guard became tiny when shield ricocheted from above 
- Fixed issue where Pandora would not shoot an arrow randomly

Improved Graphics:
- Updated graphics for tile pallet on forest floor
- Improved town building sprites 
- Added new lighting in dungeon 
- Improved / fixed shadows on objects
- Changed color of grass to match trees and updated particles 

Gameplay Updates:
- Made pit hitboxes smaller making them more forgiving
- Moved carrot boss fight spikes closer to center of room

We hope you all are enjoying the playtest and we will continue updating it as we test and get more feedback!

From,
Knights of the Island
